on.description:
At 5 stacks, reduces Physical Resistance by 10.

Assuming 100% uptime at 5 stacks. Adds -10 Physical Resistance.

Increases Qi damage taken by 10%. During Exhausted, increases HP damage taken by 10%, plus another 10% for Bellstrike damage.

Assuming 100% uptime. Adds 10% Qi damage taken; during Exhausted, adds 10% HP damage taken, plus another 10% for Bellstrike damage.

At 5 Soul-Shaken stacks, increases ordinary DoT damage by 25% (50% for Strategic Sword or Heavenquaker Spear) and High Bleed damage by 50%. Shattered Stone reduces Physical Defense by 5%.

Assuming 100% uptime at 5 Soul-Shaken stacks and 83.33% uptime (10 seconds every 12 seconds) at 1 Shattered Stone stack. Adds 25% ordinary DoT damage (50% for Strategic Sword or Heavenquaker Spear), 50% High Bleed damage, and approximately -4.17% Physical Defense.

Increases HP damage taken by 8%, plus another 10% for Might. Does not increase Qi damage.

Assuming 100% uptime. Adds 8% HP damage taken, plus another 10% for Might; no Qi damage bonus.

Reduces attribute resistances by 16 and increases HP damage taken from Strength by 8%.

Assuming 75% uptime (15 seconds every 20 seconds). Adds -12 attribute resistances and 6% HP damage taken from Strength.

strayhunt.description:
Strayhunt adds 2% Physical and attribute DMG Bonus.

Assuming 100% uptime. Adds 2% Physical and attribute DMG Bonus.

both.description:
Strayhunt adds 2% Physical and attribute DMG Bonus. Wildstride increases Replayed skill damage by 20%.

Assuming 100% uptime for both effects. Adds 2% Physical and attribute DMG Bonus and 20% Replayed skill damage.

mixed.description:
Increases damage dealt by 10% while active.

Assuming 40% uptime (12 seconds every 30 seconds). Adds 4% damage bonus.

deluge.description:
Increases damage dealt by 24% while active.

Assuming 40% uptime (12 seconds every 30 seconds). Adds 9.6% damage bonus.

yellow.description:
With Harmony Song T6, Radiant Drum adds 12% Physical and attribute attack; Rustling adds 3% attribute attack; ally Cloudshear adds 2% Physical and attribute DMG Bonus and healing.

Assuming 32.5% Radiant Drum uptime, 67.5% Rustling uptime, and 100% ally Cloudshear uptime. Adds 3.9% Physical Attack, 5.925% attribute attack, 2% Physical and attribute DMG Bonus, and 2% healing. With Museflow Waist Drum equipped, adds no external bonuses or duration changes.

blue.description:
With Harmony Song T6, Radiant Drum adds 12% Physical and attribute attack; Rustling adds 3% attribute attack; ally Cloudshear adds 2% Physical and attribute DMG Bonus and healing.

Assuming 52.5% Radiant Drum uptime, 47.5% Rustling uptime, and 100% ally Cloudshear uptime. Adds 6.3% Physical Attack, 7.725% attribute attack, 2% Physical and attribute DMG Bonus, and 2% healing. With Museflow Waist Drum equipped, instead sets local Radiant Drum duration to 10.5 seconds and disables the Dawnsun extension and fallback application.

full.description:
With Harmony Song T6, Radiant Drum adds 12% Physical and attribute attack; Rustling adds 3% attribute attack; ally Cloudshear adds 2% Physical and attribute DMG Bonus and healing.

Assuming 100% Radiant Drum uptime, 0% Rustling uptime, and 100% ally Cloudshear uptime. Adds 12% Physical Attack, 12% attribute attack, 2% Physical and attribute DMG Bonus, and 2% healing. With Museflow Waist Drum equipped, instead sets local Radiant Drum duration to 20.5 seconds and disables the Dawnsun extension and fallback application.

T1.description:
At 5 stacks, reduces Physical Defense by 6%.

Assuming 100% uptime at 5 stacks. Adds -6% Physical Defense.

T6.description:
At 5 stacks, reduces Physical Defense by 6% and Physical Resistance by 10.

Assuming 100% uptime at 5 stacks. Adds -6% Physical Defense and -10 Physical Resistance.

0.15.description:
Increases damage dealt to bosses by 15%.

Assuming 100% uptime. Adds 15% damage bonus against the boss.
